subject.title: Text between tool calls leaks to messaging channels

question: Should external source-visible turns keep automatic bare-text delivery by default, switch to final/message-tool-only delivery, or move through an opt-in migration period?
rationale: The safest leak fix changes documented channel delivery behavior and could break users who rely on automatic text replies, so automation cannot choose the permanent default alone.

options.title: Compatibility-first migration
options.body: Keep automatic delivery where explicitly configured, add a safe final/message-tool-only path for external channels, and ship doctor/docs/tests for the transition.

options.title: Strict explicit-send default
options.body: Make external messaging delivery require final-safe or message-tool semantics by default, accepting a breaking change for setups that rely on bare text replies.

options.title: Keep automatic default with opt-in fixes
options.body: Land only opt-in mitigations such as enforceFinalTag or verbose-off suppression, accepting that the central leak class remains possible by default.

recommendation.title: Compatibility-first migration
recommendation.body: Keep automatic delivery where explicitly configured, add a safe final/message-tool-only path for external channels, and ship doctor/docs/tests for the transition.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans documented visible-reply defaults, compatibility policy, and shared reply/channel delivery surfaces where @steipete has the strongest history signal.
